description: Use to get the two messages a referrer signs with fresh timestamps; returns the terms acceptance message (ISO ts) for memeswap_referral_accept and the referral message (epoch ms) for memeswap_referral_code and memeswap_referral_stats.

termsVersion.description: Defaults to the live version from /api/referrals/terms.

wallet.description: Public 0x EVM address. Never a key or seed.

name: memeswap_referral_accept_message
